column1: # The textures of the editor's ground painting (editor_ground.cpp): where to sample each one in a
# campaign ground of the player's game (maps\lNN\lNN.vid) - a 128 x 128 patch at x, y of the picture,
# laid mirrored so it tiles without seams. Nothing of the pictures is kept here, only the places.
# key: the [Editor] key of its name; english: the name in English. The order is the Paint tool's row;
# new ones go at the end (the Water tool's beds - lava, swamp, lake bed - are rows 10-12 by their place).
